options.name: fact_path
options.description: Path used for local ansible facts (C(*.ps1) or C(*.json)) - files in this dir will be run (if a ps1) or read (if a json) and their results be added to the return facts. The returned fact will be named after the local file (without the extension suffix), e.g. C(ansible_my_fact).

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: If supplied, restrict the additional facts collected to the given subset. Can specify a list of values to specify a larger subset. Values can also be used with an initial C(!) to specify that that specific subset should not be collected. To avoid collecting even the min subset, specify C(!all,!min). To collect only specific facts, use C(!all,!min), and specify the particular fact subsets.

options.name: gather_timeout
options.description: Set the default timeout in seconds for individual fact gathering.
